```yaml
name: FATFS Test
on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]
  push:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  fatfs-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-20.04
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y build-essential libssl-dev libwolfssl-dev

      - name: Configure and Build wolfSSH with FATFS
        run: |
          ./configure --enable-sftp --enable-fatfs
          make -j$(nproc)

      - name: Create FATFS Image
        run: |
          dd if=/dev/zero of=fatfs.img bs=1M count=10
          mkfs.fat -F 32 fatfs.img

      - name: Create Test File
        run: |
          echo "This is a test file for FATFS" > testfile.txt

      - name: Mount FATFS Image
        run: |
          mkdir -p /tmp/fatfs
          sudo mount -o loop fatfs.img /tmp/fatfs

      - name: Copy Test File to FATFS
        run: |
          cp testfile.txt /tmp/fatfs/
          sudo umount /tmp/fatfs

      - name: Run wolfsftp Client Test
        run: |
          ./examples/sftpclient/sftpclient -h localhost -u testuser -p testpass -l /tmp/fatfs -r /testfile.txt

      - name: Verify File Contents
        run: |
          if cmp -s testfile.txt /tmp/fatfs/testfile.txt; then
            echo "File contents match"
          else
            echo "File contents do not match"
            exit 1
          fi
```
